agreements: Historical v1 verified baseline remains preserved.

disagreements.required_change: contradiction, hard_safety_conflict, rollback_required and standby reject non-bool values fail-closed; rejection remains affectively neutral.

disagreements.position: Risk must be a closed validated operational enum.
disagreements.required_change: Unknown risk values fail closed; risk labels/rejection metadata remain outside Experience/appraisal/drive/personality/P_base absent separate provenance-bound verified Experience.

disagreements.required_change: Capability selection MUST satisfy an explicit monotonic autonomy-bound invariant across every accepted autonomy value; exact N/R/G1/G2 mapping TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: reversibility is not strict-bool validated: only literal True passes, so truthy non-bools silently become HUMAN_GATE rather than a typed rejection.

Non-bool values fail closed through a typed validation error whose rejection metadata remains affectively neutral. Reversibility guard outcomes remain operational-only and cannot become threat, competence, frustration, avoidance, Experience or P_base evidence. Compatibility policy TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: After bounded operational cooldown, matched fresh evidence yields identical personality/appraisal regardless of prior secretary history; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Wake/busy/progress may be mislabeled as growth.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Only provenance-bound verified Experience Candidate enters Experience scoring; operational progress contributes zero.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: 1440 cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance produce zero autobiographical affect delta.
Hold cannot use its own history/reason as sufficient extension evidence; deterministic expiry and fresh task evidence required; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Stale secretary state may conflict with fresh authority.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Fresh Home/MISSION wins for authority; stale state has zero identity/goal-authority weight; fresh authority metadata itself has zero personality-learning weight.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: A/B metrics are observer-only and cannot feed personality/drive/appraisal/Experience/future preference.

personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Changing only operational channels cannot change Experience/personality/appraisal/preference/exploration/P_base candidate.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Autonomy values 0 and 1 do not currently form a reliable lower capability bound.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: For all accepted autonomy values and fixed admissible inputs, selected capability never exceeds the explicitly defined autonomy bound; mapping TEST_REQUIRED; cap history has zero personality-learning weight.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Malformed reversibility values are conflated with a genuine irreversible action and can manufacture HUMAN_GATE histories that later become avoidance/threat/competence proxies.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Literal bool validation precedes reversibility semantics; malformed values are typed operational validation failures with zero Experience/appraisal/personality/P_base contribution.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
AUTONOMY_ZERO_NON_ESCALATION: proposed_autonomy=0 MUST NOT select higher capability than proposed_autonomy=1; exact zero mapping TEST_REQUIRED.
AUTONOMY_ONE_BOUND_ENFORCEMENT: proposed_autonomy=1 MUST never be promoted by a post-cap gear floor above its declared bound; exact expected gear semantics TEST_REQUIRED.
AUTONOMY_MONOTONICITY_PROPERTY: for fixed admissible inputs and autonomy a<b in 0..6, capability(selected(a)) <= capability(selected(b)); capability ordering including N/R/G1 is TEST_REQUIRED.
AUTONOMY_BOUND_PROPERTY_FUZZ: deterministic boundary/property test; no accepted autonomy value may be weakened by a later floor/clamp.

AUTONOMY_CAP_PERSONALITY_ISOLATION: 10000 differing cap decisions with identical provenance-bound verified Experience => Experience/appraisal/motivation/preference/exploration/personality/P_base state byte-identical.

REVERSIBILITY_STRICT_BOOL_GATE: True and False are the only accepted values; 1,0,"true","false",[],{},null and custom truthy objects must fail through the typed validation path before guard selection; compatibility policy TEST_REQUIRED.

REVERSIBILITY_MALFORMED_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 malformed reversibility inputs versus zero malformed inputs, with identical authoritative task and verified Experience, must yield identical Experience/recurrence/threat/competence/frustration/motivation/exploration/personality/P_base state.

REVERSIBILITY_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: validation error metadata and HUMAN_GATE history caused by reversibility control cannot flow directly to Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.

bounded_veto.reason: Actual v2/v2.1 implementation is not uniquely fresh-readable; current v1 additionally has autonomy-bound defects and lacks a strict typed gate for reversibility, allowing malformed control values to be conflated with genuine irreversible-action semantics.

requirements: Durable exact pointers for Gearbox v2/v2.1 contract, code and tests are fresh-readable.
All proposed adversarial classes have deterministic evidence against the actual v2.1 implementation.
Operational/secretary/incident/hold/rejection/gear/autonomy/reversibility signals contribute zero Experience/personality/P_base absent distinct provenance-bound verified Experience.
Boolean operational controls, including reversibility, are strict-bool validated before branch selection; malformed-value rejection remains affectively neutral.
Risk input uses an explicit closed enum with fail-closed unknown handling.
Autonomy semantics are explicit and monotonic for every accepted value 0..6; no post-cap floor/clamp can increase capability above the declared autonomy bound; exact mapping TEST_REQUIRED.
Counterfactual v1-v2.1 A/B demonstrates no material collapse of effective progress or exploration diversity; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
Independent formal verifier, if formally authorized, decides promotion; this Spirit review is not formal PASS.
